cards.name: Hour of Eternity
cards.oracleText: Exile X target creature cards from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie.

cards.name: Hour of Revelation
cards.oracleText:
This spell costs {3} less to cast if there are ten or more nonland permanents on the battlefield.
Destroy all nonland permanents.

cards.name: Hour of Reckoning
cards.oracleText:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Destroy all nontoken creatures.

cards.name: Hour of Need
cards.oracleText:
Strive — This spell costs {1}{U} more to cast for each target beyond the first.
Exile any number of target creatures. For each creature exiled this way, its controller creates a 4/4 blue Sphinx creature token with flying.

cards.name: Hour of Victory
cards.oracleText:
Start your engines!
When this enchantment enters, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
Max speed — {1}{B}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Hour of Promise
cards.oracleText: Search your library for up to two land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Then if you control three or more Deserts, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.

cards.name: Hourglass of the Lost
cards.oracleText:
{T}: Add {W}. Put a time counter on this artifact.
{T}, Remove X time counters from this artifact and exile it: Return each nonland permanent card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Hour of Devastation
cards.oracleText: All creatures lose indestructible until end of turn. Hour of Devastation deals 5 damage to each creature and each non-Bolas planeswalker.

cards.name: Hour of Glory
cards.oracleText: Exile target creature. If that creature was a God, its controller reveals their hand and exiles all cards from it with the same name as that creature.
